name: Papua New Guinea
alt: Independent State of Papua New Guinea
Territory of Papua and New Guinea (before 1975)

predecessors.name: Commonwealth of Australia
predecessors.text: the Territory of Papua and New Guinea, administered by Australia: 'setting 16 September 1975 as the date of independence'

ledger.x: 1975: Papua New Guinea becomes independent from Australia.
1991: PNG begins to retake the island.
2001: Bougainville returns to PNG authority as an autonomous region.

wars.name: Bougainville Civil War
wars.outcome: A truce in mid-1997 and the Lincoln Agreement of January 1998; the Bougainville Peace Agreement of 2001 gave autonomy; first Autonomous Bougainville Government elected in 2005.

certainty.note: Land border with Indonesia to the west; island coasts.
Bougainville: de facto BRA/BIG control, PNG holding Buka and by 1996 about 40% of the island.
Bougainville is an autonomous region from the 2001 agreement, still inside the PNG border.
